token.title: 🔑 GitHub tokɛni
token.intro: GitHub bɛ ɲininkali 60 jaabi lɛrɛ kɔnɔ adirɛsi ma min tɛ tokɛni ci. Fɔriki jiri dafalen bɛ ɲininkali 32 ɲɔgɔn ta, o de kosɔn siɲɛ filanan taama bɛ ban. Tokɛni bɛ dan yɛlɛn ka se 5000 ma lɛrɛ kɔnɔ.
token.step1: Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens da wuli, o kɔ Generate new token.
token.step2: Resource owner: i yɛrɛ ka jatebɔsɛbɛn. Expiration: don o don, jiri man kan ni fɛn ye min bɛ mɛn.
token.step4: I kana sira si maga. Bɛɛ ka maralanw ka meta kunnafoniw man kan ni u si ye.
token.step5: A dilan, o kɔ {token} hakɛ kopi. GitHub b'a jira siɲɛ kelen dɔrɔn.
token.classic: Tokɛni kɔrɔ fana bɛ baara kɛ: kelen dilan k'a sɔrɔ dan si ma sugandi. Dan lankolon fana bɛ se ka bɛɛ ka kunnafoniw kalan ni dantigɛlenw ka teliya ye.
token.stays: A bɛ to lajɛlan nin kɔnɔ kile {key} jukɔrɔ, a bɛ taa {host} dɔrɔn ma. A tɛ sɛbɛn adirɛsi bara kan abada, o de kosɔn siri min b'i fɛ ka tila, o bɛ jiracogo ta, a tɛ dantigɛli ta. Butɔn min bɛ yɔrɔ in jukɔrɔ, o b'a jɔsi tugun ni waatidɔ marali ye.
token.persistHow: Tokɛni don {env} dosiye kɔnɔ sɛrɛwɛri min bɛ nin ɲɛ in mara, {port} kɛrɛfɛ:
token.proxy: ka a daminɛ ni {make} ye. O kɔ kɔntɛni bɛ nginx tilayɔrɔ dɔ sɛbɛn min bɛ {header} kunkolo fara {path} proxy kan, o de kosɔn lajɛlan b'a yɛrɛ bɔyɔrɔ wele, a tɛ tokɛni sɔrɔ abada. Nin yɔrɔ in bɛ tunun, lajɛbagaw bɛɛ bɛ dan kelen tila min ye 5000 ye lɛrɛ kɔnɔ.
fork.refused404: Bolofara cilan si tɛ: {message}. 404 yan ye bolofara ye min tɛ yen, walima sira min sɛrɛwɛri proxy tɛ ta; fɔriki jɛɲɔgɔnya min bɛ sanfɛ, o dafalen don hali cogo o cogo.
fork.refusedExhausted: GitHub ka ɲininkaliw banna nin lɛrɛ in kɔnɔ, o de kosɔn bolofara cilan si ma se ka ja. Fɔriki jɛɲɔgɔnya min bɛ sanfɛ, o dafalen don. Tokɛni fara sɛgɛsɛgɛli panɔ kan, walima bolofara cilanw faga cogoya panɔ kɔnɔ walasa ɲininkaliw ka baara jɛɲɔgɔnya dama la.
fork.refusedOther: GitHub ye jaabi {status} di komitiw tariku ko la, o de kosɔn bolofara cilan si ma se ka ja. Fɔriki jɛɲɔgɔnya min bɛ sanfɛ, o dafalen don.
fork.tagsOrphaned: Don tɛ tagi la, o de kosɔn tɔw kelen-kelen bɛɛ tun bɛna ɲininkali kelen sɔngɔ ta, lɛrɛ in ka ɲininkali tolenw tɛ baara o la.
